title: Optimal Symmetries in Binary Classification
abstract: arXiv:2408.08823v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a theoretical foundation for designing group-equivariant neural networks that align the choice of symmetries with the underlying probability distributions of the data. Utilising the general structure of fibre decompositions on the domain under group equivariant maps and its relation to that of the likelihood ratio, we present a theoretical framework for identifying group actions that maintain optimal classification performance via the Neyman-Pearson lemma. This provides a unified methodology for improving classification accuracy especially in fundamental applications where one has knowledge of the inherent symmetries of the distributions and how they are broken by measurement. As an application to jet classification at the Large Hadron Collider, we find that there can be performance gains when one utilises smaller permutation symmetries within the constituents. translated_title: 二分类中的最优对称性
translated_abstract: 我们为设计群等变神经网络建立了一个理论基础，使对称性的选择与数据的潜在概率分布保持一致。利用群等变映射下定义域上纤维分解的一般结构及其与似然比结构之间的关系，我们提出了一个理论框架，通过Neyman-Pearson引理来识别能够保持最优分类性能的群作用。这为提高分类精度提供了一种统一的方法论，尤其适用于那些已知分布固有对称性以及测量如何破坏这些对称性的基础应用场景。作为在大型强子对撞机喷注分类中的应用，我们发现利用成分内部更小的置换对称性可以获得性能提升。这项工作为构建群等变神经网络提供了见解和实用指南。
tldr: 本文基于Neyman-Pearson引理提出了一个理论框架，用于为群等变神经网络选择与数据概率分布相匹配的最优对称性，并在大型强子对撞机喷注分类中证明利用更小的置换对称性可以带来性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theoretical framework based on the Neyman-Pearson lemma for selecting optimal symmetries in group-equivariant neural networks aligned with the underlying data distributions, demonstrating performance gains in LHC jet classification by exploiting smaller permutation symmetries.
